title: Global Population Growth
explanation: The world population has experienced continuous growth following the Great Famine of 1315–1317 and the end of the Black Death in 1350, when it was near 370 million.

title: Rising Global Temperatures
explanation: Global temperatures have risen significantly since the pre-industrial era, heavily driven by human activities such as fossil fuel burning.

title: Box Office Revenue Growth
explanation: Movie industry revenues have steadily climbed over decades with major blockbuster releases pushing records higher every year.

title: Music Streaming Dominance
explanation: Streaming has overtaken physical sales and digital downloads to become the primary way the world consumes music.
